# Antigravity Swarm Plaza 🏢🎮 [![CI](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/releases) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v1.3.2-ffd147) 🇬🇧 **English** | [🇹🇷 **Türkçe**](README.tr.md) | [🇨🇳 **简体中文**](README.zh-CN.md) > A 2.5D retro isometric gamified dashboard and native IDE Auxiliary Pane sidecar extension that visualizes Google Antigravity autonomous multi-agent systems and swarms as living, breathing office workers across skyscraper floors. --- ## 📸 Visual Showcase Gallery

🎬 Live Demo Walkthrough — 2.5D Day Office → Night Mode & Star Wars Costume Party → Plaza Tower Exterior.

🏢 Main 2.5D Isometric Office (Daylight) — Acoustic wood-slat walls, panoramic skyline windows, diverse female & male pixel employees, dual-monitor desks, and mini-room props.

🌙 Alternate Blueprint, Night Mode & Events


Alternate 16×14 floor layout, ambient night light pools, and live floor events 		🏙️ Plaza Tower Skyscraper Exterior


Curtain-wall glass facade, neon SWARM PLAZA crown, double-height lobby, and elevator
🕸️ Live Swarm Board & @mention Graph


Auto-scrolling message feed with clickable ● LIVE follow and directed @mention graph 		📊 60-Minute Analytics & Telemetry


60-minute activity bar chart, completed task counters, and model distribution
⚙️ Game-Style Graphics & System Settings


One-click FPS/DPR profiles (60 FPS Classic default), AA, static cache, and system toggles 		📅 Vertical Gantt & Swarm Whiteboard


Side-by-side agent swimlanes, real date blocks, HH:MM timeline, and Personnel Roster
📱 IDE Auxiliary Side-Pane Compact Mode (< 760px)
  • Compact Toolbar: Secondary controls automatically bundle into a clean ⋯ overflow menu.
  • Slide-Over Floor Drawer: Floor selector collapses into a quick ELEVATOR ▾ drawer to save horizontal space.
  • Full-Width 2.5D Office: Preserves crisp 100% canvas visibility inside narrow IDE side panes.
  • Companion Navigation Pill: Bundled plugin/rules/AGENTS.md surfaces [Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/) right alongside Open the Swarm UI.
--- ## 🏛️ Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph AGY["Google Antigravity (~/.gemini/antigravity)"] DB["conversation_summaries.db\n(?mode=ro)"] LOGS["logs/transcript.jsonl\n(Read-Only Stream)"] SWARM["swarm/board.jsonl\n(Multi-Agent Board)"] PROJECTS["config/projects/*.json\n(Renamed Projects)"] end subgraph CORE["Swarm Plaza Core Engine"] SCANNER["Read-Only DB, Project & Brain Scanner"] GAME["Gamification & Zone Logic\n(XP, Model Outfits, Events, Go-Home)"] API["Express & WebSocket Server\n(127.0.0.1 Loopback)"] end subgraph CLIENT["Presentation Modes"] SIDECAR["Antigravity Auxiliary Side Pane\n(plugin:// Sidecar Extension)"] WEB["Standalone Browser\n(http://localhost:3210)"] end DB --> SCANNER LOGS --> SCANNER SWARM --> SCANNER PROJECTS --> SCANNER SCANNER --> GAME GAME --> API API -->|"/preload.js + Token Rewrite"| SIDECAR API -->|"WebSocket /ws + Static Assets"| WEB ``` --- ## 🌟 Key Features & What's New (v1.3.2) - **🧭 Unified Workflow & Vertical Gantt (`🧭 WORKFLOW & GANTT`) with Curved Bezier SVG Topology:** - Combines the interactive `@mention` handoff topology and Vertical Gantt timeline into a single unified tab (`WorkflowDiagramSvg.tsx`), featuring an amphitheater blueprint layout (`★ BOSS HUB`, `@all` broadcast node, role-colored agent cards), non-overlapping quadratic Bezier arrows with `×N` frequency badges, and bidirectional click-to-filter sync with the scrollable `HH:MM` Gantt rows below. - **🚨 Clickable Topbar `! N` Error Badge, Smart Alert Center & `📜 Go to Logs` Inspection Flow:** - Displays a live pulsing red **`! N`** badge in `TopHud` whenever active floor employees encounter errors or health stalls; clicking opens `AlertHistoryModal` with `×N` grouping, severity filters, and **`🔍 INSPECT AGENT`** to jump straight into the agent's RPG Card—complete with a top red error banner (`⚠️ Error detected • N consecutive errors`), `HP` badge, and one-click **`📜 GO TO LOGS`** highlighting `ERROR` steps. - **⚙️ Game-Style Graphics & System Settings + Decluttered Top Bar:** - Dedicated **`⚙️ SETTINGS`** modal with one-click performance presets (**`⚡ Classic Smooth 60 FPS`** default, `⚖️ Balanced 30 FPS`, `🌱 Power Saver Eco`, `🔥 Ultra Native`), Resolution Scale (`0.75x` / `1.0x` / `2.0x` / `Native DPR`), Anti-Aliasing (`Pixel Crisp` / `Smooth`), Frame Rate Limit (`Eco 14–24` / `30` / `60` / `Unlimited`), Static Architecture Cache toggle, and a **Live FPS** readout. - Decluttered desktop toolbar keeping only core navigation and floor actions, while moving `Follow Cam`, `Day/Night`, `Demo Mode`, `SFX`, `Browser Alerts`, and `TR/EN` into Settings with `localStorage` persistence. - **👥 Illustrated Personnel Roster (`👥 PERSONNEL ROSTER`) & Back-to-List RPG Navigation:** - Live `64×64` 2.5D pixel-art portraits for every active agent on the floor, paired with current activity/task summary, model badge, `~Estimated` credit & token usage, `HP` health bar, and one-click RPG Card inspection with a top-left **`⬅ BACK TO LIST`** button to jump straight back to the roster. - **📅 Vertical Gantt Work Plan (`📅 WORK PLAN (GANTT)`):** - Side-by-side agent columns on the horizontal axis and real date blocks (`📅 YYYY-MM-DD`) with an `HH:MM` clock timeline on the vertical axis, color-coded phase blocks (`📊 Plan`, `🔍 Analyze`, `💻 Code`, `🧪 Test`, `☕ Break`), and a **`⬆️/⬇️` flow direction toggle**. - **📋 Task Flow (`📋 TASK FLOW (DAG)`) & Golden Desk Verification Trophies:** - Active-scene-only `@mention` handoff graph, task cards, and golden pixel verification trophies (`drawDeskVerifiedTrophy`) that appear on 2.5D desks when agents report `PASS / DONE / EXIT 0 / ✅` proof. - **🛡️ Agent Health (`0–100 HP`), `~Estimated` Cost Monitor & `×N` Smart Alert Grouping:** - Passive micro-HP bars on agent cards and desks, `~Estimated` token & cost breakdown in `AnalyticsModal`, and filterable alert notifications that deduplicate repeated alerts with `×N` badges. - **⚡ Eco-Canvas GPU Optimizer & Smart Break Events:** - Offscreen static architecture cache + Adaptive FPS Limiter (`0 FPS` when hidden, `4 FPS` behind open modals, `14–24 FPS` active scene) cutting GPU usage by ~85%, plus a minimum 2-agent-on-break rule (`MIN_BREAK_AGENTS_FOR_SOCIAL_EVENT = 2`) and `150s` inter-event cooldown for automatic social/costume events. - **🧩 Embedded Antigravity Auxiliary Pane UI Extension (Sidecar):** - Runs natively inside the Antigravity IDE Auxiliary Side Pane with one-click launch via `[Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/)`. - Automatically binds to Antigravity's dynamic port (`ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT`) with `127.0.0.1` loopback security and `X-Sidecar-Token` authentication. - Transparent HTML asset token rewriting (`rewriteHtmlWithSidecarToken`), `/preload.js` bridge, and a 1500ms HTTP polling fallback to ensure flawless rendering under Electron's `plugin://` scheme without white flashes. - **Responsive Compact Mode (`< 760px`):** Narrow side panes automatically collapse the floor panel into a slide-over drawer (`ASANSÖR ▾`), bundle secondary actions into a `⋯` menu, and preserve 100% full-width isometric canvas rendering. - **🏢 Plaza Skyscraper & Fixed Elevator Foyer:** - Every Antigravity project maps to its own dedicated company floor (`K0` Lobby, `K1..KN` Projects, and Penthouse Demo Floor). - Automatically resolves user-renamed Antigravity project display names from `~/.gemini/config/projects/*.json` (e.g. `"Bursa Veriler"`). - Fixed left-wall elevator entrance (`gx: 0, gy: 6..7`) across all blueprints with brushed-steel sliding doors that open when agents arrive or depart. - **👔 BOSS, Diverse Male & Female Pixel Characters & 8 Model Outfits:** - Swarm coordinators are prominently styled as **★ BOSS** seated at an executive mahogany desk with a golden crown. - Expressive female & athletic V-taper male 2.5D pixel employees (oval chibi faces, eye sparkle, wavy/bob/ponytail/bun female hairstyles, 3-tier flared skirts & tailored suits; 3 male outfits `classic_suit` / `tech_hoodie` / `vest_ensemble`, 4-layer voluminous hair, focused gaze, optional `light_stubble`) paired with synchronized `96×96` RPG character portraits. - 8 distinct model families feature unique outfits and accessories: `argon` (Purple blazer + crown), `hydrogen` (Cyan tech hoodie + headphones), `flash` (Emerald/Yellow racing jacket + visor), `carbon` (Crimson lab coat + cyber specs), `pro` (Navy/Gold suit + tie), `claude` (Terracotta knit sweater + beanie), `gpt` (Teal turtleneck + headset), `other` (Indigo polo + badge). - **📐 Full 2.5D Office Architecture, Ambient Lighting & 5 Mini-Room Props:** - Richly textured floors (warm parquet, acoustic carpet, perforated server metal, marble lobby), acoustic wood-paneled & panoramic city-view back walls, beveled dual-monitor desks, ergonomic chairs, espresso bar, soft contact shadows, window/server/lounge radial light pools, and a refreshed `PLAZA TOWER` glass curtain-wall facade. - Real partitioned rooms (Executive Suite, Dev/QA Studio, Conference War Room, Server Room, and Lounge) plus 5 custom 2.5D mini-room props (`phone_booth`, `snack_vending`, `arcade_cabinet`, `library_table`, `3d_printer`) filling dead zones across `16×14` floors. - 100% camera-facing (`SE` / `SW`) seated angles, low tabletop ergonomics (`10px`), and corner monitors ensure characters' faces and expressions are never occluded. - 5 theme palettes across 5 architectural layouts yield 25 distinct combinations (`🎲 LAYOUT`). - **☕ Living Agent Lifecycle & Go-Home Timer (`AGY_GO_HOME_MINUTES`):** - **Seated Keyboard Coding:** Ergonomic swivel chairs, mechanical keyboard typing, and floating `` code glyphs. - **War Room Presentations & Teleportation:** Active speaker holds a laser pointer stick directing attention to the illuminated Presentation Screen (`presenting`), while invited teammates teleport in via 2.5D pixel beam & isometric rings (`playTeleportZap()`) or sit as attentive listeners (`meeting`). - **Lounge Relaxation & 2-Player Console Gaming:** Idle agents relax on plush sofas (`lounging`) or pair up for retro console fighting/racing games (`gaming`). - **Shift End / Go-Home:** Agents inactive for `8` minutes walk toward the elevator (`going_home`), leaving the office at `9.5` minutes to complete their shift (`offDutyCount`). - **⚡ Random Office Events & Costume Parties (`⚡ EVENT` & 65s Auto-Loop):** - `STAR_WARS_PARTY` (Jedi, Sith, Rebel, Mandalorian), `SUPERHERO_PARTY`, and `HALLOWEEN_PARTY` (Witch, Pumpkin, Vampire, Ghost) with 4 deterministic costume variants per agent, ambient canvas particles, and synchronized 96x96 RPG portraits, alongside `PIZZA_PARTY`, `WATERCOOLER_GOSSIP`, `SPRINT_CELEBRATION`, `MASCOT_ZOOMIES`, and `COFFEE_BREW`. - *Real-Work Integrity:* Active working agents (`status === 'working'`) are NEVER pulled off their desks during ambient events. - **📡 Live Swarm Board, `@mention` Network Graph & 60m Analytics:** - Unified message stream ingesting both Native Swarm `board.jsonl` and subagent/task `messages/*.json`, with automatic scroll-to-latest (`MESSAGE FEED`), clickable `● LIVE` follow toggle, and clean `@Swarm Worker (...)` badge normalization. - Directed `@mention` communication network graph modal (`WhiteboardModal`) + **`TASK FLOW (DAG)`** tab tracking task ownership, handoffs, and keyword-verified proof badges (`PASS`, `DONE`, `EXIT 0`, `VERIFIED`, `✅`). - **Operational AI Agent Control Center:** Passive **Agent Health (0–100 HP)** micro-bars, golden desk proof trophies for verified outputs, `~Estimated` per-agent Token & Cost Monitor (`AnalyticsModal`), and Smart Alert Grouping (`×N` deduplication + severity filters). - 60-minute activity telemetry timeline (12x 5-minute buckets), completed task counters, and model distribution (`AnalyticsModal`). - **🌐 Automatic Browser Language Detection & Complete i18n:** - Automatically starts in Turkish if browser/OS language is Turkish (`tr*`), otherwise defaults to English (`en`). Instant `TR | EN` toggle updates all server speech bubbles, demo company names, and event titles in real time. - **🛡️ 100% Read-Only Safety:** - Strictly read-only: SQLite uses `?mode=ro`, transcripts and brain directories are scanned via read-only file streams. Never writes, locks, or alters user data in `~/.gemini/antigravity`. --- ## 📐 Architectural Blueprints & Pets Table | Blueprint | Layout Name | Desk Ergonomics | Room Partitioning | Office Pet & Amenity | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **0** | **Classic Corner Studio** | `clover_desk` (4-person Clover Pod) | Glass Partitions | Aquarium (Swimming fish & bubbles) | | **1** | **Central Meeting Island** | `single_desk` (Spaced Individual Desks) | Wood Partitions | Tabby Cat (`tabby_cat`) & Cozy Poufs | | **2** | **Open L-Plan Tech Lab** | `bench_desk` (Startup Bench Row) | Hybrid Partitions | Robo-Vac (`robo_vac`) & Ping-Pong Table | | **3** | **Dual-Wing Corporate** | `u_pod_desk` (U-Shaped Team Pod) | Full Glass Walls | Office Dog (`office_dog` - Corgi) | | **4** | **Creative Penthouse Loft**| `twin_desk` (Paired Duo Desks) | Brick & Wood | Tuxedo Cat (`tuxedo_cat`), Bonsai & Aquarium | --- ## ⚡ Instant Run (`npx`) ### Try in 1 Command (Zero Clone) Run immediately from GitHub or npm without cloning or manual build steps (Node.js `>= 22.5.0` required): ```bash # Run directly from GitHub in interactive demo mode npx github:akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza --demo # Or via npm package npx antigravity-swarm-plaza --demo ``` ### CLI Command Flags | Flag | Short | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `--demo` | `-d` | Starts with interactive demo mode enabled (5 Pure-Gemini model agents) | | `--port ` | `-p ` | Sets a custom HTTP/WebSocket port (default: `3210` or `$PORT`) | | `--no-open` | | Disables automatic browser launch on startup | | `--workspace ` | `-w ` | Highlights a specific workspace directory as the active floor | | `--install-plugin` | | Installs the extension into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-swarm-plaza` | | `--help` | `-h` | Displays CLI usage help | | `--version` | `-v` | Prints current version number | --- ## 🧩 Antigravity Extension Installation (IDE Sidecar) To install Swarm Plaza as a native Auxiliary Pane extension and skill directly inside Google Antigravity: ```bash npx antigravity-swarm-plaza --install-plugin ``` Once installed, simply click the sidecar pill in Antigravity chat: - `[Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/)` - When the plugin is installed and enabled, its bundled `plugin/rules/AGENTS.md` rule automatically surfaces the companion `[Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/)` pill alongside `[Open the Swarm UI](sidecar://swarm/swarm_board/)` (and disappears automatically when the plugin is disabled). --- ## 🚀 Development & Test Suite ```bash # Clone repository git clone https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza.git cd antigravity-swarm-plaza # Install dependencies npm install # Run automated tests (73 tests / 25 test suites) npm test # Run TypeScript verification npm run typecheck # Build client, server, and sidecar bundle npm run build # Start standalone server npm start ``` --- ## ⚙️ Environment Variables | Variable | Default | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `PORT` | `3210` | Web server and WebSocket port | | `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT` | | Dynamic port assigned by Antigravity for the auxiliary pane (takes priority) | | `HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Local loopback bind host for security | | `AGY_DATA_DIR` | `~/.gemini/antigravity` | Antigravity root data directory (read-only inspection) | | `AGY_WORKSPACE` | `process.cwd()` | Workspace path used to detect and highlight the active project floor | | `AGY_GO_HOME_MINUTES` | `8` | Inactivity threshold before agents head to the elevator (minutes) | --- ## 📄 License MIT License. Designed and crafted for the Google Antigravity Multi-Agent Ecosystem.

# Antigravity Swarm Plaza 🏢🎮 [![CI](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/releases) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v1.3.2-ffd147) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.5.0-3be87a) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3cd8ff) ![Sidecar](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sidecar-Ready-b07cff) [🇬🇧 **English**](README.md) | [🇹🇷 **Türkçe**](README.tr.md) | 🇨🇳 **简体中文** > 一款 2.5D 复古像素等距视角游戏化监控面板与原生 IDE 侧边栏（Auxiliary Pane）扩展插件，将 Google Antigravity 多智能体系统（Swarm）可视化为摩天大楼各楼层中鲜活工作的办公室员工。
--- ## 📸 界面展示画廊 (Visual Showcase Gallery)

🎬 实时演示动图 — 2.5D 日间办公室 → 夜间模式与星球大战换装派对 → 广场大楼外观。

🏢 主界面 2.5D 等距办公室（日间） — 声学木格栅墙面、全景城市天际线窗户、精致男女像素员工、双屏办公桌与迷你房间家具。

🌙 备用蓝图、夜间模式与楼层活动


备用 16×14 楼层布局、夜间径向环境光效与实时楼层派对活动 		🏙️ 广场大楼外观视图


钢肋玻璃幕墙、楼顶霓虹 SWARM PLAZA 标志、挑高玻璃大堂与观光电梯
🕸️ Swarm 白板与 @mention 关系网


自动滚动消息流、可点击 ● LIVE 实时追踪按钮与有向 @mention 拓扑图 		📊 60 分钟活动分析与遥测


60 分钟活动柱状图、已完成任务统计与多模型分布视图
⚙️ 游戏级图形与系统设置


一键 FPS/DPR 预设（默认 60 FPS 经典流畅）、抗锯齿、静态缓存与系统偏好设置 		📅 纵向甘特图与 Swarm 白板


并列智能体泳道、真实日期分组、HH:MM 时间线与图文人员名录
📱 IDE 辅助侧边栏紧凑模式（< 760px）
  • 紧凑工具栏： 次要操作按钮自动收拢进整洁的 ⋯ 菜单。
  • 滑出式楼层抽屉： 楼层选择器折叠为快捷电梯抽屉，最大化节省横向空间。
  • 全宽 2.5D 办公室： 即使在窄侧边栏中也能保持 100% 清晰的等距画布视野。
  • 伴随导航胶囊： 内置 plugin/rules/AGENTS.md 规则会在 Open the Swarm UI 旁自动提供 [Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/) 入口。
--- ## 🏛️ 系统架构 (Architecture Diagram) ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph AGY["Google Antigravity (~/.gemini/antigravity)"] DB["conversation_summaries.db\n(node:sqlite readOnly)"] LOGS["logs/transcript.jsonl\n(只读流式扫描)"] SWARM["swarm/board.jsonl\n(多智能体消息板)"] PROJECTS["config/projects/*.json\n(重命名项目识别)"] end subgraph CORE["Swarm Plaza 核心引擎"] SCANNER["只读数据库、项目与 Brain 扫描器"] GAME["游戏化与区域状态机\n(XP、模型服饰、事件、下班逻辑)"] API["Express 与 WebSocket 服务\n(127.0.0.1 本地回环)"] end subgraph CLIENT["前端展示模式"] SIDECAR["Antigravity 辅助侧边栏\n(plugin:// Sidecar 扩展)"] WEB["独立浏览器视图\n(http://localhost:3210)"] end DB --> SCANNER LOGS --> SCANNER SWARM --> SCANNER PROJECTS --> SCANNER SCANNER --> GAME GAME --> API API -->|"/preload.js + Token 重写"| SIDECAR API -->|"WebSocket /ws + 静态资源"| WEB ``` --- ## 🌟 核心特性与新功能 (Core Features & v1.3.2) - **🧭 弧形贝塞尔 SVG 拓扑与纵向甘特图一体化视图 (`🧭 WORKFLOW & GANTT`)：** - 将交互式 `@mention` 交接拓扑图与纵向甘特时间线合二为一（`WorkflowDiagramSvg.tsx`），采用半圆蓝图布局（`★ BOSS HUB`、`@all` 广播节点、按角色着色的智能体卡片）、防重叠二次贝塞尔箭头与 `×N` 频次徽章，并支持点击节点/连线实时联动筛选下方可滚动的 `HH:MM` 甘特行。 - **🚨 顶部栏可点击 `! N` 告警徽章、智能告警中心与 `📜 GO TO LOGS` 排障流：** - 当楼层活跃智能体出现错误或健康停滞时，`TopHud` 顶部栏会亮起红色 **`! N`** 徽章；点击即可打开支持 `×N` 分组与严重级别筛选的 `AlertHistoryModal`，点击 **`🔍 INSPECT AGENT`** 可直达对应智能体 RPG 卡片顶部的红色错误横幅（`⚠️ Error detected • N consecutive errors`）、`HP` 徽章以及一键高亮 `ERROR` 日志行的 **`📜 GO TO LOGS`** 按钮。 - **⚙️ 游戏级图形与系统设置 + 精简顶部工具栏：** - 配备独立 **`⚙️ SETTINGS`** 弹窗，支持一键切换性能预设（默认 **`⚡ 经典流畅 60 FPS`**、`⚖️ 均衡 30 FPS`、`🌱 省电 Eco`、`🔥 极致 Native`）、分辨率缩放（`0.75x` / `1.0x` / `2.0x` / `Native DPR`）、抗锯齿（`像素锐利` / `平滑`）、帧率上限（`Eco 14–24` / `30` / `60` / `无限制`）、静态建筑缓存开关及 **实时 FPS** 指示器。 - 精简桌面端顶部栏，仅保留核心楼层与导航操作；`跟随镜头`、`昼夜切换`、`Demo 模式`、`音效 SFX`、`浏览器提醒` 与 `TR/EN` 语言切换统一移入设置弹窗并通过 `localStorage` 持久化保存。 - **👥 图文人员名录 (`👥 PERSONNEL ROSTER`) 与 `⬅ BACK TO LIST` RPG 返回导航：** - 为楼层中每位活跃智能体实时渲染 `64×64` 2.5D 像素肖像，展示当前任务/活动摘要、模型徽章、`~Estimated` 积分与 Token 消耗、`HP` 健康条，并支持一键打开 RPG 角色卡及左上角 **`⬅ BACK TO LIST`** 快速返回名录。 - **📅 纵向甘特工作计划 (`📅 WORK PLAN (GANTT)`)：** - 横轴并列展示各智能体泳道列，纵轴按真实日期分组 (`📅 YYYY-MM-DD`) 与 `HH:MM` 时分时间线排列，配备彩色阶段块（`📊 Plan`、`🔍 Analyze`、`💻 Code`、`🧪 Test`、`☕ Break`）及 **`⬆️/⬇️` 流向切换开关**。 - **📋 任务流 (`📋 TASK FLOW (DAG)`) 与桌面黄金验证奖杯：** - 仅包含当前场景活跃智能体的 `@mention` 交接关系图、任务卡片，以及在检测到 `PASS / DONE / EXIT 0 / ✅` 验证凭证时自动出现在 2.5D 办公桌上的黄金像素奖杯（`drawDeskVerifiedTrophy`）。 - **🛡️ 智能体健康度 (`0–100 HP`)、`~Estimated` 成本监控与 `×N` 智能告警分组：** - 角色卡与桌面微缩 `HP` 健康条、`AnalyticsModal` 中的 `~Estimated` 资源与成本分布，以及按严重级别过滤并使用 `×N` 合并重复提醒的通知中心。 - **⚡ Eco-Canvas GPU 性能优化与智能休息事件规则：** - 离屏静态建筑缓存 + 自适应帧率限制器（页面隐藏 `0 FPS`、弹窗打开 `4 FPS`、活跃场景 `14–24 FPS`），降低约 85% GPU 占用；自动社交/变装派对事件需满足楼层至少 2 名智能体处于休息/等待状态（`MIN_BREAK_AGENTS_FOR_SOCIAL_EVENT = 2`）且事件间隔冷却至少 `150s`。 - **🧩 嵌入式 Antigravity 侧边栏插件 (Sidecar Extension):** - 安装后可在 Antigravity IDE 的 **Auxiliary Side Pane** 中通过 `[Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/)` 一键打开。 - 自动绑定 Antigravity 动态分配端口（`ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT`），并采用 `127.0.0.1` 本地回环安全策略与 `X-Sidecar-Token` 鉴权。 - 内置透明静态资源 Token 重写（`rewriteHtmlWithSidecarToken`）、`/preload.js` 桥接脚本及 1500ms HTTP 轮询兜底，确保 Electron `plugin://` 协议下零白屏稳定渲染。 - **响应式紧凑模式（`< 760px`）：** 窄侧边栏自动将楼层列表折叠为抽屉（`ASANSÖR ▾`），次要操作收入 `⋯` 菜单，保持 100% 全宽等距画布视野。 - **🏢 广场摩天大楼与固定电梯厅：** - 每个 Antigravity 项目映射为大楼的独立楼层（`F0` 大厅、`F1..Fn` 项目层与顶层 Demo 演示层），支持从 `~/.gemini/config/projects/*.json` 自动识别重命名后的工作区名称。 - 所有 5 套建筑蓝图统一配备左侧固定电梯口（`gx: 0, gy: 6..7`）与拉丝钢自动滑门，员工入职与下班时自动开合。 - **👔 多样化男女 2.5D 像素员工、RPG 肖像与模型服饰：** - 精致女性与运动型 V-Taper 男性 2.5D 像素角色：女性配备椭圆 Q 版脸型、眼部高光、长发/波波头/马尾/丸子头与 3 层百褶短裙/剪裁西装；男性提供 3 种服饰风格（`classic_suit`、`tech_hoodie`、`vest_ensemble`）、4 层立体蓬松发型、专注神态及可选轻盈胡茬（`light_stubble`），并与 `96×96` RPG 角色肖像卡实时同步。 - Swarm 协调者以 **★ BOSS** 身份戴金色皇冠坐镇红木行政桌；8 大模型家族拥有专属装扮：`Argon`（紫金西装+皇冠）、`Hydrogen`（青色卫衣+耳机）、`Flash`（翡翠/金赛车服+护目镜）、`Carbon`（深红实验服+赛博眼镜）、`Pro`（海军蓝/金西装）、`Claude`（陶土针织毛衣+冷帽）、`GPT`（青绿高领+耳麦）、`Other`（靛蓝工装+工牌）。 - **📐 完整 2.5D 办公建筑、氛围光影与 5 种迷你房间家具：** - 实木地板/地毯/冲孔金属/大理石纹理地面、吸音木饰面与全景城市天际线背墙、双屏斜切办公桌、人体工学椅与浓缩咖啡吧；搭配柔和接触阴影、窗户/机房/休息区径向光池以及焕新升级的 `PLAZA TOWER` 玻璃幕墙摩天大楼立面。 - 真实隔断房间布局（行政套房、开发与 QA 区、会议作战室、服务器机房、休息室），并利用 **电话亭**（`phone_booth`）、**零食售货机**（`snack_vending`）、**街机柜**（`arcade_cabinet`）、**阅览桌**（`library_table`）和 **3D 打印机**（`3d_printer`）填充角落与死角区域。 - 5 套蓝图搭配 5 套主题调色盘，组合出 25 种独特办公室风格（`🎲 LAYOUT`）。 - **⚡ 作战室全息传送 (`⚡`) 与 11 种随机事件 / 主题派对：** - **作战室召唤与全息传送：** 协调者发起会议时使用激光教鞭演示；受邀成员触发 2.5D 全息传送光柱、扩散等距光环与 `playTeleportZap()` 8-bit 音效直达会议座。 - **11 种趣味活动与派对：** 包含 **星球大战**（`STAR_WARS_PARTY` — 绝地/西斯/反抗军/曼达洛人）、**超级英雄**（`SUPERHERO_PARTY`）、**万圣节**（`HALLOWEEN_PARTY` — 女巫/南瓜头/吸血鬼/幽灵）三大主题换装派对（每位员工 4 种变体 + 画布粒子 + RPG 肖像同步），以及 `PIZZA_PARTY`、`WATERCOOLER_GOSSIP`、`SPRINT_CELEBRATION`、`MASCOT_ZOOMIES`、`COFFEE_BREW` 等。工作中的智能体（`status === 'working'`）绝不会被环境事件打断。 - **8-bit 合成器音效（Chiptune SFX）：** 纯 Web Audio API 零外部音频文件，支持静音持久化。 - **📡 实时 Swarm 白板、`@mention` 网络图与 60 分钟遥测：** - 同时汇聚原生 Swarm `board.jsonl` 与子智能体/后台任务 `messages/*.json`（含 `@Swarm Worker (...)` 标签规范化），支持 `MESSAGE FEED` 打开即自动滚动至最新消息、可点击 `● LIVE` 实时追踪按钮以及悬浮未读跳转提示。 - 有向 `@mention` 交互网络图（`WhiteboardModal`）与 **`TASK FLOW (DAG)` 任务流图标签页**（支持 `PASS`、`DONE`、`EXIT 0`、`VERIFIED`、`✅` 消息关键词自动验证徽章），以及 60 分钟活动时间轴、模型分布统计（`AnalyticsModal`）。 - **运营级 AI 智能体控制中心：** 被动式 **Agent Health (0–100 HP)** 微型生命条、桌面金色验证奖杯、带 `~Estimated`（约估算）标识的 AI 资源与成本监控（`AnalyticsModal`）以及智能告警聚合（`×N` 去重 + 严重级别筛选）。 - 支持楼层 `T1..T5` 评级、Pure-Gemini 生态/配额评分、PNG 高清导出、昼夜模式切换与多语言自动识别（`EN` / `TR`）。 - **🛡️ 100% 只读安全架构：** - 所有数据源严格只读：`node:sqlite` 以 `{ readOnly: true }` 打开，`transcript.jsonl` 与 `brain` 目录采用只读流扫描，服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 回环地址，绝不修改或锁定 `~/.gemini/antigravity` 中的任何用户数据。 --- ## 📐 建筑蓝图与宠物一览 (Blueprints & Pets) | 编号 | 蓝图名称 | 工位风格 | 隔断样式 | 办公室宠物与设施 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **0** | **Classic Corner Studio** | `clover_desk`（四人四叶草工位） | 玻璃隔断 | 水族箱（游动热带鱼与气泡） | | **1** | **Central Meeting Island** | `single_desk`（独立宽松工位） | 原木隔断 | 虎斑猫（`tabby_cat`）与懒人沙发 | | **2** | **Open L-Plan Tech Lab** | `bench_desk`（创业长条工位） | 混合隔断 | 扫地机器人（`robo_vac`）与乒乓球台 | | **3** | **Dual-Wing Corporate** | `u_pod_desk`（U 型团队岛台） | 全景玻璃墙 | 办公室柯基犬（`office_dog`） | | **4** | **Creative Penthouse Loft**| `twin_desk`（双人联排工位） | 砖墙与原木 | 奶牛猫（`tuxedo_cat`）、盆栽与水族箱 | --- ## ⚡ 快速开始与命令行参数 (Quick Start & CLI Options) ### 一行命令快速体验（无需克隆） 无需克隆仓库或手动构建，直接运行（需要 Node.js `>= 22.5.0`）： ```bash # 直接从 GitHub 启动交互式演示模式 npx github:akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza --demo # 或通过 npm 包运行 npx antigravity-swarm-plaza --demo ``` | 参数 | 简写 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `--demo` | `-d` | 开启交互式演示模式（5 个 Pure-Gemini 模拟智能体） | | `--port ` | `-p ` | 指定 HTTP/WebSocket 端口（默认 `3210` 或 `$PORT`） | | `--no-open` | | 启动时不自动打开系统默认浏览器 | | `--workspace ` | `-w ` | 指定高亮显示的项目工作区路径 | | `--install-plugin` | | 将插件安装至 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-swarm-plaza` | | `--help` | `-h` | 显示命令行帮助 | | `--version` | `-v` | 打印当前版本号 | --- ## 🧩 Antigravity IDE 侧边栏插件与快捷入口 将 Swarm Plaza 安装为 Google Antigravity 原生辅助侧边栏扩展与技能： ```bash npx antigravity-swarm-plaza --install-plugin ``` 安装完成后，在 Antigravity 对话中点击侧边栏胶囊即可打开： - `[Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/)` - 当插件处于安装并启用状态时，内置规则 `plugin/rules/AGENTS.md` 会在原生 `[Open the Swarm UI](sidecar://swarm/swarm_board/)` 胶囊旁自动提供伴随入口 `[Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/)`（禁用插件后自动停止提示）。 --- ## 🚀 开发与测试 (Development & Testing) ```bash # 克隆仓库 git clone https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza.git cd antigravity-swarm-plaza # 安装依赖 npm install # 启动开发模式 npm run dev # 运行 TypeScript 类型检查 npm run typecheck # 运行自动化测试（73 个单元测试 / 25 个测试套件） npm test # 构建前端、服务端与 Sidecar 单文件包 npm run build # 启动生产服务 npm start ``` --- ## ⚙️ 环境变量 (Environment Variables) | 变量名 | 默认值 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `PORT` | `3210` | Web 服务与 WebSocket 监听端口 | | `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT` | | Antigravity 为侧边栏分配的动态端口（优先级最高） | | `HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | 绑定本地回环地址以确保安全 | | `AGY_DATA_DIR` | `~/.gemini/antigravity` | Antigravity 根目录路径（仅只读扫描） | | `AGY_WORKSPACE` | `process.cwd()` | 用于识别并高亮当前项目楼层的工作区路径 | | `AGY_GO_HOME_MINUTES` | `8` | 无活动后员工走向电梯下班的阈值（分钟） | --- ## 📄 开源协议 (License) 基于 **MIT License** 开源。专为 Google Antigravity 多智能体生态设计与打造。

# Antigravity Swarm Plaza 🏢🎮 [![CI](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/akinba/antigravity-swarm-plaza/releases) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v1.3.2-ffd147) 🇬🇧 **English** | [🇹🇷 **Türkçe**](README.tr.md) | [🇨🇳 **简体中文**](README.zh-CN.md) > A 2.5D retro isometric gamified dashboard and native IDE Auxiliary Pane sidecar extension that visualizes Google Antigravity autonomous multi-agent systems and swarms as living, breathing office workers across skyscraper floors. --- ## 📸 Visual Showcase Gallery

🎬 Live Demo Walkthrough — 2.5D Day Office → Night Mode & Star Wars Costume Party → Plaza Tower Exterior.

🏢 Main 2.5D Isometric Office (Daylight) — Acoustic wood-slat walls, panoramic skyline windows, diverse female & male pixel employees, dual-monitor desks, and mini-room props.

🌙 Alternate Blueprint, Night Mode & Events


Alternate 16×14 floor layout, ambient night light pools, and live floor events 		🏙️ Plaza Tower Skyscraper Exterior


Curtain-wall glass facade, neon SWARM PLAZA crown, double-height lobby, and elevator
🕸️ Live Swarm Board & @mention Graph


Auto-scrolling message feed with clickable ● LIVE follow and directed @mention graph 		📊 60-Minute Analytics & Telemetry


60-minute activity bar chart, completed task counters, and model distribution
⚙️ Game-Style Graphics & System Settings


One-click FPS/DPR profiles (60 FPS Classic default), AA, static cache, and system toggles 		📅 Vertical Gantt & Swarm Whiteboard


Side-by-side agent swimlanes, real date blocks, HH:MM timeline, and Personnel Roster
📱 IDE Auxiliary Side-Pane Compact Mode (< 760px)
  • Compact Toolbar: Secondary controls automatically bundle into a clean ⋯ overflow menu.
  • Slide-Over Floor Drawer: Floor selector collapses into a quick ELEVATOR ▾ drawer to save horizontal space.
  • Full-Width 2.5D Office: Preserves crisp 100% canvas visibility inside narrow IDE side panes.
  • Companion Navigation Pill: Bundled plugin/rules/AGENTS.md surfaces [Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/) right alongside Open the Swarm UI.
--- ## 🏛️ Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph AGY["Google Antigravity (~/.gemini/antigravity)"] DB["conversation_summaries.db\n(?mode=ro)"] LOGS["logs/transcript.jsonl\n(Read-Only Stream)"] SWARM["swarm/board.jsonl\n(Multi-Agent Board)"] PROJECTS["config/projects/*.json\n(Renamed Projects)"] end subgraph CORE["Swarm Plaza Core Engine"] SCANNER["Read-Only DB, Project & Brain Scanner"] GAME["Gamification & Zone Logic\n(XP, Model Outfits, Events, Go-Home)"] API["Express & WebSocket Server\n(127.0.0.1 Loopback)"] end subgraph CLIENT["Presentation Modes"] SIDECAR["Antigravity Auxiliary Side Pane\n(plugin:// Sidecar Extension)"] WEB["Standalone Browser\n(http://localhost:3210)"] end DB --> SCANNER LOGS --> SCANNER SWARM --> SCANNER PROJECTS --> SCANNER SCANNER --> GAME GAME --> API API -->|"/preload.js + Token Rewrite"| SIDECAR API -->|"WebSocket /ws + Static Assets"| WEB ``` --- ## 🌟 Key Features & What's New (v1.3.2) - **🧭 Unified Workflow & Vertical Gantt (`🧭 WORKFLOW & GANTT`) with Curved Bezier SVG Topology:** - Combines the interactive `@mention` handoff topology and Vertical Gantt timeline into a single unified tab (`WorkflowDiagramSvg.tsx`), featuring an amphitheater blueprint layout (`★ BOSS HUB`, `@all` broadcast node, role-colored agent cards), non-overlapping quadratic Bezier arrows with `×N` frequency badges, and bidirectional click-to-filter sync with the scrollable `HH:MM` Gantt rows below. - **🚨 Clickable Topbar `! N` Error Badge, Smart Alert Center & `📜 Go to Logs` Inspection Flow:** - Displays a live pulsing red **`! N`** badge in `TopHud` whenever active floor employees encounter errors or health stalls; clicking opens `AlertHistoryModal` with `×N` grouping, severity filters, and **`🔍 INSPECT AGENT`** to jump straight into the agent's RPG Card—complete with a top red error banner (`⚠️ Error detected • N consecutive errors`), `HP` badge, and one-click **`📜 GO TO LOGS`** highlighting `ERROR` steps. - **⚙️ Game-Style Graphics & System Settings + Decluttered Top Bar:** - Dedicated **`⚙️ SETTINGS`** modal with one-click performance presets (**`⚡ Classic Smooth 60 FPS`** default, `⚖️ Balanced 30 FPS`, `🌱 Power Saver Eco`, `🔥 Ultra Native`), Resolution Scale (`0.75x` / `1.0x` / `2.0x` / `Native DPR`), Anti-Aliasing (`Pixel Crisp` / `Smooth`), Frame Rate Limit (`Eco 14–24` / `30` / `60` / `Unlimited`), Static Architecture Cache toggle, and a **Live FPS** readout. - Decluttered desktop toolbar keeping only core navigation and floor actions, while moving `Follow Cam`, `Day/Night`, `Demo Mode`, `SFX`, `Browser Alerts`, and `TR/EN` into Settings with `localStorage` persistence. - **👥 Illustrated Personnel Roster (`👥 PERSONNEL ROSTER`) & Back-to-List RPG Navigation:** - Live `64×64` 2.5D pixel-art portraits for every active agent on the floor, paired with current activity/task summary, model badge, `~Estimated` credit & token usage, `HP` health bar, and one-click RPG Card inspection with a top-left **`⬅ BACK TO LIST`** button to jump straight back to the roster. - **📅 Vertical Gantt Work Plan (`📅 WORK PLAN (GANTT)`):** - Side-by-side agent columns on the horizontal axis and real date blocks (`📅 YYYY-MM-DD`) with an `HH:MM` clock timeline on the vertical axis, color-coded phase blocks (`📊 Plan`, `🔍 Analyze`, `💻 Code`, `🧪 Test`, `☕ Break`), and a **`⬆️/⬇️` flow direction toggle**. - **📋 Task Flow (`📋 TASK FLOW (DAG)`) & Golden Desk Verification Trophies:** - Active-scene-only `@mention` handoff graph, task cards, and golden pixel verification trophies (`drawDeskVerifiedTrophy`) that appear on 2.5D desks when agents report `PASS / DONE / EXIT 0 / ✅` proof. - **🛡️ Agent Health (`0–100 HP`), `~Estimated` Cost Monitor & `×N` Smart Alert Grouping:** - Passive micro-HP bars on agent cards and desks, `~Estimated` token & cost breakdown in `AnalyticsModal`, and filterable alert notifications that deduplicate repeated alerts with `×N` badges. - **⚡ Eco-Canvas GPU Optimizer & Smart Break Events:** - Offscreen static architecture cache + Adaptive FPS Limiter (`0 FPS` when hidden, `4 FPS` behind open modals, `14–24 FPS` active scene) cutting GPU usage by ~85%, plus a minimum 2-agent-on-break rule (`MIN_BREAK_AGENTS_FOR_SOCIAL_EVENT = 2`) and `150s` inter-event cooldown for automatic social/costume events. - **🧩 Embedded Antigravity Auxiliary Pane UI Extension (Sidecar):** - Runs natively inside the Antigravity IDE Auxiliary Side Pane with one-click launch via `[Swarm Plaza](sidecar://antigravity-swarm-plaza/swarm_plaza/)`. - Automatically binds to Antigravity's dynamic port (`ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT`) with `127.0.0.1` loopback security and `X-Sidecar-Token` authentication. - Transparent HTML asset token rewriting (`rewriteHtmlWithSidecarToken`), `/preload.js` bridge, and a 1500ms HTTP polling fallback to ensure flawless rendering under Electron's `plugin://` scheme without white flashes. - **Responsive Compact Mode (`< 760px`):** Narrow side panes automatically collapse the floor panel into a slide-over drawer (`ASANSÖR ▾`), bundle secondary actions into a `⋯` menu, and preserve 100% full-width isometric canvas rendering. - **🏢 Plaza Skyscraper & Fixed Elevator Foyer:** - Every Antigravity project maps to its own dedicated company floor (`K0` Lobby, `K1..KN` Projects, and Penthouse Demo Floor). - Automatically resolves user-renamed Antigravity project display names from `~/.gemini/config/projects/*.json` (e.g. `"Bursa Veriler"`). - Fixed left-wall elevator entrance (`gx: 0, gy: 6..7`) across all blueprints with brushed-steel sliding doors that open when agents arrive or depart. - **👔 BOSS, Diverse Male & Female Pixel Characters & 8 Model Outfits:** - Swarm coordinators are prominently styled as **★ BOSS** seated at an executive mahogany desk with a golden crown. - Expressive female & athletic V-taper male 2.5D pixel employees (oval chibi faces, eye sparkle, wavy/bob/ponytail/bun female hairstyles, 3-tier flared skirts & tailored suits; 3 male outfits `classic_suit` / `tech_hoodie` / `vest_ensemble`, 4-layer voluminous hair, focused gaze, optional `light_stubble`) paired with synchronized `96×96` RPG character portraits. -
